description: This file defines a PHP class for supporting PostgreSQL version 7 in an ADODB database abstraction layer, including methods for querying, foreign key retrieval, character set management, and recordset handling specific to PostgreSQL 7.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres7
classes.description: Class extending ADODB_postgres64 to support PostgreSQL 7 with features like limit support, foreign keys, and charset management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres7
classes.description: Recordset class for PostgreSQL 7, providing data retrieval and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres7
classes.description: Enhanced recordset supporting associative array features for PostgreSQL 7.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Modifies SQL to add LIMIT and OFFSET, providing limited result sets.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key metadata information from PostgreSQL system catalogs.

methods.name: GetCharSet
methods.description: Returns the current client character set encoding.

methods.name: SetCharSet
methods.description: Sets the client character set encoding for the PostgreSQL connection.
